newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: UBS CEO expects good 1997 profit growth.
newsitem.headline: UBS CEO expects good 1997 profit growth.

text.p: Union Bank of Switzerland chief executive Mathis Cabiallavetta said that he expected favourable growth in the bank's profits in 1997.
"Next year should bring good growth in profits," he said when asked about profit prospects for the coming year.
But he also said the result would depend in part on how markets performed.
Cabiallavetta was speaking at a news briefing to announce a domestic restructuring at the bank.

UBS reported a net profit in 1995 of 1.673 billion Swiss francs. On October 28 it reported that nine-month results were higher than a year earlier but that earnings growth had lagged somewhat in the third quarter. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
